title: Circular A.R.M.N. No. 28/2023: General Framework for Triple Sustainability Governance (الإطار العام لحوكمة الاستدامة الثلاثية)
citation: Central Bank of Libya, Circular A.R.M.N. No. (28/2023) dated 27 Jumada I 1445 (11 December 2023)
evidence: The official PDF, read by OCR, heads the circular "المنشور أرم ن رقم (28/ 2023) ... التاريخ: 27 جمادى الاول 1445 الموافق: 11 ديسمبر 2023" with the subject "الاطار العام لحوكمة الاستدامة الثلاثية"; it has no commencement clause, so the issue date is used.
duty_on: banks and specialised banks (annual sustainability disclosure, carbon-footprint measurement and ESG criteria on a phased timetable from January 2024)
notes: Link only: row LY-CBL-ADOPTED is permission requested (site footer: all rights reserved). The PDF is an image-only scan with no text layer; the text was read by OCR for checking only. The circular is addressed to banks and specialised banks supervised by the Central Bank; its section 8 (implementation mechanism) sets the timetable: awareness and training January to June 2024, initial application March to December 2024 (carbon footprint of head office by end of June 2024). Its disclosure section says binding disclosure standards are to follow. No English version found on cbl.gov.ly. Not found on any official page on 2026-11-09: a Libyan climate act, an emissions trading or carbon tax rule, Law No. 15 of 2003 on the Protection and Improvement of the Environment (secondary copies only), and a Libyan capital-market sustainability disclosure rule (lsm.ly did not answer). Law No. 23 of 2010 on Commercial Activities, as published by WIPO Lex (ly007en.pdf, sha256 d99dbfff0ceff4d93fbc83cb97e6ef2d48edf91b6998010894aa87cfde63fba6), is not the Commercial Code with a consumer-protection title: its competition chapter (Art. 1286) covers intellectual-property infringement only, so it is not a F6 instrument.
